text:
PulseForge is a fast-growing fintech startup building a real-time payments orchestration platform used by banks and large merchants. We move quickly, ship often, and obsess over reliability — we need engineers who can help us keep a complex distributed system rock-solid as we scale.

What you'll do
- Design, build and maintain automated test suites for frontend and backend components to ensure high quality releases.
- Develop end-to-end, integration and regression tests using Selenium and Test Automation best practices.
- Integrate and maintain test pipelines in Jenkins to enable continuous testing and fast feedback loops.
- Create and run API test scenarios and collections using Postman; validate contracts and error handling.
- Triage, reproduce and track defects; work closely with developers and product to drive fixes and improvements.
- Mentor junior testers, review test designs and help establish test strategy and quality metrics.

What we need (mandatory)
- Proven experience with Selenium.
- Strong background in Test Automation.
- Hands-on experience setting up and maintaining Jenkins pipelines.
- Practical experience using Postman for API testing.
- 6+ years of relevant experience working on complex, cross-functional products.
- Comfortable working in a startup-style fast-paced environment and collaborating across teams.

Bonus points (preferred / good-to-have)
- Playwright
- TestNG
- Cypress
- pytest

Location & work mode
Hybrid: Bengaluru or Chennai, 3 days a week in the office.
